description: Con Edison: Hosting Capacity is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. (ConEd Networks)・ Hosting capacity of a distribution system refers to the amount of Distributed Energy Resources (DER) that can be accommodated without adversely impacting power quality or reliability under existing control configurations and without requiring infrastructure upgrades. Coverage: the United States. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Renewables. Its keywords are hosting capacity, hosting capacity maps. The portal shows 2024-05-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is No license, or terms of use, asserted by data producer for this dataset was found.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
